thread:
Daniel (Sec): Heads-up: we're tightening assume-role defaults. Effective 2026-05-05 00:00 UTC we'll reduce maximum session duration for cross-account roles from 12h to 1h and require MFA or session tags for all privileged roles. Please review roles you own.

aws-bot: Org audit 2026-04-10 -> 73 roles allow 12h sessions; 19 roles have no MFA enforcement. Report: https://go/internal/aws-assume-role-audit

Marta (IAM): Why the change? Compliance flagged long-lived sessions as a risk for lateral movement. Shorter sessions + MFA reduces blast radius. We'll also enable conditional role trust checks for source IP and session tags where possible.

Eli (SRE): Enforcement behavior? Will existing tokens be invalidated immediately?

Daniel (Sec): Enforcement plan: 2026-04-20 - owners notified (done). 2026-05-05 00:00 UTC - org policy will cap CreateSession/AssumeRole to 1h unless the role has an approved exception. Tokens already issued with longer TTL will remain until expiry but new sessions cannot request >1h.

Nora (Platform): Migration helpers? We have automation?

Marta (IAM): Yes: `tools/assume_role_migrate.py --org redwood --dry-run` will scan roles, propose minimal trust policy changes (MFA requirement or session tag condition), and open PRs to the IaC repo. It won't apply changes without review. Docs: https://go/internal/assume-role-migration

Eli (SRE): Some pipelines rely on 6-8h sessions for long-running maintenance. What's the exception path?

Daniel (Sec): Exceptions allowed only for scheduled maintenance with compensating controls (justification, start/end times, runbook, and monitoring). Submit via https://go/internal/sec-exceptions. Approvals: infra lead + sec manager. Temporary exceptions capped at 72h and logged.

Marta (IAM): Quick policy snippet for requiring MFA in the role trust:
```
"Condition": {
  "Bool": {"aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent": "true"}
}
```

Nora (Platform): For programmatic non-interactive flows, use session tags issued by our token broker (token-broker.redwood) to carry identity and TTL. Update SDK usage to pass `SessionTags`. Migration doc covers examples for boto3 and aws-sdk-js.

aws-bot: Reminder scheduled every 3 days until enforcement date.

Eli (SRE): I'll run the migration tool against our maintenance roles and open PRs this week.

Marta (IAM): We'll also start an audit job to emit alerts when any role requests >1h. Alert goes to #eng-security and oncall.

Daniel (Sec): Please prioritize control-plane and deployment roles. Post any blockers here. We'll publish a compliance snapshot 2026-05-04 17:00 UTC. Thanks folks. :lock:
